comments.text: Tile 0 of tile set 2, blank as in every set: 554 squares of the set's tile layers (map 27: 29, the black squares of its 8 x 8 checkerboard; map 32: 385; 33: 140), 12 class-4 squares of maps 27 and 33, and map 5's off-map edge. Set 2 serves eleven maps of side 2: 2 (its text: 'You step out of Scott's bar.'), 3 ('Leaving Stagecoach Inn.'), 4, 5, 6 ('Leaving the courthouse.'), 27 ('Leaving the Temple of Blood.'), 28, 31, 32 and 33 ('Leaving Downtown.') and 34 ('Leaving Police station.').

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares (1 grey robot-like humanoid, 2 red and orange one-eyed hulk, 3 yellow and green runner, 4 man in a cyan shirt, 5 tied sack, 6 brown horned creature). Map 27's layer puts 2 on three squares, (14, 13) on its checkerboard and (14, 22), (15, 22) below it. Computed from the records, encounter squares would show 4 (map 2: 5, 3: 9, 4: 33, 27: 2, 28: 12, 32: 11, 33: 1, 34: 7) or 6 (map 3: 1, 4: 8, 28: 5), and map 31's one encounter 3; tile 5 shows on 11 loot-bag squares (map 4: 4, 32: 1, 33: 2, 34: 4).

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure drawn on the party's square by game $AF1D-$AF25. In set 2's maps it is also the commonest person: 105 squares of the tile layers (map 2: 47, 3: 6, 4: 1, 6: 3, 27: 21, 31: 1, 32: 8, 33: 11, 34: 7) and 7 class-4 squares (maps 2, 3, 6, 32, 33); on map 33 seven squares whose layer holds 7 are class 4 and show floor 58 instead. draw_tile's self-modified LDA operand ($2367) points here: tile 7 was drawn last.

Tile 8, the radiation sign draw_square shows on class-9 squares from 18:00 to 05:59 ($0B80-$0B8A). Set 2 has one such square, map 31's (26, 26), whose layer tile is the barrel 85; no layer of the set holds 8.
Tile 9 of set 2, a purple peak over light blue and blue bars (as in sets 1, 3-5, 7 and 8): what game $AD13-$AD49 draws for each other party of the player's on the same map. In no layer of the set.

Tiles 10-14 of set 2: 10 a brown chair seen side-on, its back at the right (73 squares on maps 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 27, 32 and 33; three class-4 squares of map 33 show it too); 11 a small white hut under a blue roof, unused by the maps; 12 blank, unused; 13 and 14 the left and right halves of a purple slab with a grey rim, one in most of map 3's small rooms (10 each) and a few on maps 6, 27 and 32.

Tiles 15-21 of set 2, orange blocks shaded brown on their right or bottom edges (15 with a dark frame beside it). 15: 83 squares, 16: 19, 17: 42, 18: 22, 19: 19, 20: 41, 21: 22, some on each of the eleven maps: on map 2 the 15s stand between chairs and the 17s run down x 3, y 12-27, beside the stems 69; on map 3, 16-21 ring the pool at x 9-18, y 12-15; map 33's class-4 squares show 15 four times and 20 three times.

Tiles 22 and 23 of set 2: 22 a blue cube drawn in perspective, unused by the maps; 23 a corner of grey rock with red specks (7 squares of map 27's rock; its class-4 square (25, 6) shows 23 over a layer 44).

Tiles 24-31 of set 2: 24, 27 and 28 blue water with a white edge at the top and left, the top, or the top and right, unused by the maps; 25 rows of red dashes on black, a floor (344 squares: map 4: 79, 5: 86, 6: 40, 27: 52, 34: 87; one class-4 square of map 4 shows it); 26 white rungs between red and blue rails, unused; 29 rows of white dashes on blue (map 27, a 2 x 3 block at (8-9, 18-20), class 2); 30 solid blue over a white bottom edge, the south side of map 3's pool (row 15, x 9-18); 31 a blue and white blob (map 27 at (10, 5)).

Tiles 32-36 of set 2: 32 an orange door in a dark grey frame with a white knob (127 squares on all eleven maps, 27 of them class 10, the exits); 33 a white frame of light blue panes (map 4: 2, 6: 4, 34: 6, class 2); 34 grey bars between white rails (18 squares on maps 4, 6, 27, 31, ten of them class 10); 35 the same chair with its back at the left (44 squares); 36 brown rungs between brown rails (19 squares, seven class 10; five class-4 squares of map 33 show it).

Tiles 37-41 of set 2: 37 a green tree on a brown trunk (map 6: 31; map 33: 6); 38 black and white checks (map 27 at (30, 1), class 10); 39 white rungs between light red dashes (map 34 at (3, 6) and (3, 7)); 40 a corner of grey rock with green specks (map 27: 7); 41 a purple lattice of rings, unused by the maps.

Tiles 42-45 of set 2: 42 and 45 blue water speckled light blue, map 3's pool (4 and 16 squares, with solid blue 92 and the edge 30); 43 the same water under a white top edge, unused; 44 a diagonal edge of grey rock (6 squares of map 27; its class-4 square (25, 3) shows 44 over a layer 23).

Tiles 46-50 of set 2, grey rock with black gaps: the rock edges of maps 4, 27, 31, 32 and 33 (46: 30, 47: 24, 48: 26, 49: 28 squares) and the plain rock 50 (830 squares: map 4: 177, 27: 54, 28: 122, 31: 477), which is also the off-map tile of maps 28 and 31; nearly all class 11.

Tiles 51-54 of set 2: 51 two white upright lines on black (map 3 at (5, 22), (5, 23), (5, 26), (5, 27)); 52 a blue square outline on black (map 27's four corners of the checkerboard, which are class 4 and show 95 or 0, and map 31: 2); 53 and 54 grey and white rubble (66 and 207 squares). On map 33, 120 class-4 squares have 54 in the layer and show the tile of their action record instead: walls 90 (39 squares), floor 58 (43), blank 0 (10), bands 76 (10), rungs 36 (5), blocks 15 and 20 (7), chairs 10 (3), the figure 7 (2) and the post 74 (1).

Tiles 55-58 of set 2, red dashes on black: 55 with a dark grey left edge, unused; 56 with a dark grey bottom edge (map 28 at (15, 12)); 57 rows of dashes (767 squares: map 2: 566, 5: 140, 27: 34, 31: 16, 32: 11); 58 a few scattered dots, the floor of all eleven maps (2968 squares) and the off-map tile of maps 2, 3, 4, 6, 27, 32, 33 and 34 (record byte $33 = $3A); 54 class-4 squares of maps 27 and 33 show 58.

Tiles 59-63 of set 2: 59 a brown and dark grey frame open to the left (map 2 at (20, 26), (24, 26), (20, 27), (24, 27)); 60 a diagonal edge of grey rock with green specks (map 27: 6); 61 short red dashes in a grid, a floor (305 squares: map 4: 81, 5: 39, 6: 45, 27: 53, 34: 87); 62 black with one blue dot, unused; 63 grey and white streaks (map 6 at (16, 31), class 10).

Tiles 64-71 of set 2: 64 and 65 blue water streaked red (map 28: 221 and 254 squares, nearly all class 2; the map's text calls it 'a great body of bloody water'); 66 a light green shape with two black eyes and a mouth (map 31 at (29, 9), class 1); 67 red dashes, unused; 68 a green car-like shape over dark grey and black (map 33 at (8, 13), on the black band of tile 0 across y 12-16); 69 a round red top on a white and grey stem (13 class-2 squares of map 2 in a column at x 4, y 11-26, beside the block 17); 70 green, blue and brown with a white bar, unused; 71 a red cross on white, unused.

Tiles 72-77 of set 2: 72 brown planks laid in alternating directions (33 squares of map 2 at x 1-2, y 12-28, on the other side of the block 17); 73 green and purple bars in a white frame (map 27: 3); 74 a brown post with white and yellow dashes (map 32: 20, 33: 9; one class-4 square of map 33); 75 and 76 blue and light blue bands edged grey and white, running north-south (53 squares on maps 3, 4, 6, 27) and east-west (66 on maps 3, 4, 6, 27, 33; 11 class-4 squares of map 33 show 76); 77 green dashes, unused.

Tiles 78-83 of set 2: 78, 79, 82 and 83 white bricks with dark grey shading, wall pieces (140, 135, 107 and 129 squares on maps 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 31 and 34, all class 11 but one); 80 blue water streaked red like 64 (map 28: 105 squares); 81 blank, unused.

Tiles 84-89 of set 2: 84 two grey upright lines on black, unused; 85 an orange barrel banded white (map 31 at (26, 26), a class-9 square, so from 18:00 to 05:59 it shows the radiation sign 8); 86 a blue cube, unused; 87 a blue and white diagonal shape (map 33 at (28, 2)); 88 white bricks beside a green upright strip, in no layer but the tile of map 4's class-4 record 6 ($3FAA), which the check square (1, 5) becomes when a rope is used there (check record 3, $3B38); 89 a yellow diagonal line over red dots, unused.

Tiles 90-95 of set 2: 90 white bricks, the walls of all eleven maps (2969 squares, nearly all class 11; map 33's class-4 squares show it 39 times); 91 red dots with a dark grey left edge (map 4 at (14, 29)); solid fills 92 blue (10 squares of map 3's pool), 93 orange (map 2: 10, map 28: 4), 94 purple (map 2 at (27, 11) and (28, 11)), 95 white (every pixel pair 11; the 30 white squares of map 27's checkerboard, class 1, and two class-4 squares).

Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 2 (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low nibble: pairs 10): the shared figures 0-8 ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76) and tile 9's $46, $46, $E6, $E6, the same bytes as sets 1 and 3-5, 7, 8.

Colour bytes of tiles 10-21 in set 2: $97 over $99 (brown with yellow and brown) for the chair 10; $66, $6E, $65 for the hut 11; $46/$4C and $4C (purple with blue or grey) for the slab 13-14; $8C, $89 and $86 (orange with grey, brown or blue) for the orange blocks 15-21.

Colour bytes of tiles 22-41 in set 2: $E6 (light blue, blue) for the water and cube tiles, some with a $26 cell; $CB with a $25 or $5B cell for the rock corners 23 and 40; $26 for the floor 25, the rungs 26 and the pool edge 30; $16 (white, blue) for 29; $8B (orange, dark grey) for the door 32; $EB for the window 33; $CB for 34; $96 with a $26 cell for the chair 35; $9B for the ladder 36; $56 over $59 for the tree 37; $26 with an $A6 cell for the checks 38; $AB for 39; $46 for the lattice 41.

Colour bytes of tiles 42-63 in set 2: $E6 for the water 42, 43 and 45; $CB (grey, dark grey) for the rock 44, 46-50, 53, 54 and 63, with a $26 cell in 44 and $5B in 60; $2B and $26 (red, dark grey, blue) for the frames and red floors 51, 55, 56; $26 for 52, 57, 58, 61, 62; $9B for the frame 59.

Colour bytes of tiles 64-77 in set 2: $26 for the bloody water 64-65 and the oddments 67 and 71; $D5 with a $D6 cell for the green face 66; $5B for the car 68; $29 over $BC (red, brown, dark grey, grey) for the red-topped stem 69; $56 over $96 for 70; $96 and $99 for the parquet 72; $54 and $24 (purple bars) for 73; $96, $97, $94 for the post 74; $6E and $C6 for the band 75, $EC, $EC, $26, $E6 for 76; $75, $55, $25 for 77.

Colour bytes of tiles 78-95 in set 2: $1B (white, dark grey) for the brick walls 78, 79, 82 and 83; $26 for 80, 81 and 92, and $26 with a $56 cell for 95; $BC for 84; $88 and $8B for the barrel 85; $E6 with a $26 cell for 86; $6E and $26 for 87; $D1, $51, $21 for 88; $26 and $27 for 89; $12 and $16 (white, red, blue) for the walls 90; $2B and $26 for 91; $89, $86, $82 for the orange 93; $24 and $54 for the purple 94.
